description: The bounded settings-value query and the accepted queryProject summary (delivery.md §3). The checker re-derives the resolved maps (defaults ⊕ explicit, registry order) and the committed-fixture summary counts (from fixtures/m3/storage/project-v3-demo-0003). The HTTP/WS/stdio-MCP/browser evidence is packet 71.

querySettings.note: resolved = the six registry defaults in registry order; explicit is never default-filled
only the authored key differs from the default; the other five are the registry defaults; args absent ≡ args {} (no revision/requestId — query semantics)
every key authored ⇒ resolved == explicit (registry order in both)
a v1 envelope (no content) ⇒ both maps empty (the M1 module set has no settings keys)

querySettingsErrors.note: any field other than the empty object is rejected (the query failure code set)

querySettingsErrors.rule: every success result carries the revision the values were read at; a stale caller detects drift from the result alone (no second channel)

queryProjectSummary.rule: The accepted queryProject content summary (commands.md §5.6, CC-45-6) with the normative count semantics (C64-2). v1 envelopes carry no content field. Counts only — never definitions/declarations/byte lengths.

committedFixture.note: the checker re-derives this object from the fixture envelope (never trust the recorded value)

mcpParity.rule: tl_content_query gains querySettings in its QUERY_OPS list (delivery.md §3.3); the tool routes the same envelope and returns the same result/revision over stdio as the HTTP command path (C07 agreement).

clientHydration.rule: The editor settings panel hydrates from querySettings on connect and on every resync (reconnect, stale-edit retry, undo/redo change records): resolved initializes the values; explicit marks the authored non-defaults. No default-based seeding fallback (the client.ts:199–207 behavior is an implementation defect under this rule — packet 71 repair). No second catalog, no new mutable settings store: the panel state is a projection of the backend values advanced by the applied setSettings change records (the accepted sessions.md §8 convergence).
